name: Swarm Studio
personality: shows the work as it happens
plain about what runs locally and what leaves the machine
audience_feeling: I typed one line and watched a team of agents build my site in front of me.
promise: A swarm of agents designs and builds a multi-page website live on a canvas, inside Hermes Agent.

preferred_terms.swarm: the pool of section agents working at the same time
preferred_terms.canvas: the live board where pages and sections appear
preferred_terms.brief: the one-line description of the site the user wants

avoid: claims about speed or quality the runs do not show
calling generated sites finished apps before the App tab builds them
secrets, tokens or private paths in any copy or image
good_examples: Give it a one-line brief and a dozen agents build the pages while you watch.
bad_examples: Revolutionary AI that builds perfect production websites instantly.
status_note: Drawn from the README at install time; owner review pending.
